package-private bounded primitive byte sink shared by the raw encoders: reset(maximum, hint) keeps at most 64 KiB of scratch, append / appendLE16 / append(range) refuse past the output cap, finish() copies the exact bytes (output never aliases scratch)

opt-in LZ4 raw block encoder (no frame): token nibbles + 255-run extensions, little-endian 16-bit offsets up to 65,535, last match starting at least 12 bytes before the end and the last 5 bytes literal (LZ4 block format end-of-block rules); one reusable sink and candidate index per instance, one worker per instance

opt-in Snappy raw (unframed) encoder: uncompressed-length varint, literal tags (1..4 extra length bytes above 60), COPY_2 tags (length 1..64, little-endian 16-bit offset), matches split into 64-byte copies; no frame, chunk or CRC

closure of both encoders: single-probe four-byte-prefix candidate table (positions, keys, epochs; 2^8..2^20 slots), epoch isolation instead of a clear, exact key re-check before a candidate is returned
closure of both encoders: format-neutral LZ byte kernels commonPrefix (Arrays.mismatch), commonPrefixes (batch lanes), copyMatch (overlapping back-reference expansion)

donor wire oracle: 1,600 seeded inputs + one 250,000-byte block through both encoders, exact SHA-256 of the wire bytes (Snappy c2740cd2..., LZ4 96998fbf...), exact-cap and cap-1 refusals, input immutability, sink reset / trim / aliasing checks; optional M3WR corpus file argument
